title: Simulation 3D General Aviation Pack
text: Generate translation and rotation information for general aviation aircraft, 30 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Engine translation} sets the option to enable Engine1_T input port, {Engine rotation} sets the option to enable Engine1_R input port, {Rudder translation} sets the option to enable Rudder_T input port, {Elevator translation} sets the option to enable Elevator_T input port, {Left aileron translation} sets the option to enable Left_Aileron_T input port, {Right aileron translation} sets the option to enable Right_Aileron_T input, {Flaps translation} sets the option to enable Flaps_T input port, {Left spoiler translation} sets the option to enable Left_Spoiler_T input port, {Right spoiler translation} sets the option to enable Right_Spoiler_T input, {Rudder rotation} sets the option to enable Rudder_R input port, {Elevator rotation} sets the option to enable Elevator_R input port, {Left aileron rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Aileron_R input port, {Right aileron rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Aileron_R input, {Flaps rotation} sets the option to enable Flaps_R input port, {Left spoiler rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Spoiler_R input port, {Right spoiler rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Spoiler_R input, {Nose gear translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_T input port, {Nose wheel translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_T input port, {Left gear translation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_T input port, {Left wheel translation} sets the option to enable Left_Wheel_T input port, {Right gear translation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_T input port, {Right wheel translation} sets the option to enable Right_Wheel_T input port, {Nose gear rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_R input port, {Nose wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_R input port, {Left gear rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_R input port, {Left wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Wheel_R input port, {Right gear rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_R input port and {Right wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Wheel_R input port. Values come from the instance.
